_files: Field -> file in this folder. `icon.png` is a 24x24 mark that fills BOTH seats;
the logos are the sidebar wordmark and are theme-switched, so the pair matters:
the light-theme wordmark is dark ink and the dark-theme one is light ink.
A raster does not invert with the theme, which is why a single file cannot
serve both and both are shipped.
